title: Dynamic vendor confidence score & onboarding fastlane for procurement
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Summary: Build a conditional onboarding fastlane for vendor procurement that computes a vendor confidence score from automated security questionnaire results, SOC2 evidence attachments, and insurance metadata. The score drives a tiered onboarding flow: minimal review for low-risk vendors, automated contract generation for medium-risk vendors, and an expedited security engineering review path for high-risk vendors. Goals: reduce procurement average time-to-complete by 40% for mid-market customers, standardize SOC2 evidence intake, and enable dynamic pricing/contract clauses based on risk tier. Scope: 1) Questionnaire schema & scoring rules, 2) Evidence upload and verification checklist, 3) Insurance verification microflow (thresholds + expirations), 4) UI fastlane in vendor portal + API endpoints for programmatic vendors, 5) Contract template selection and auto-populate variables, 6) Audit log and export for legal/compliance. Out of scope: manual supplier negotiations and SSO integration for this phase.
acceptance_criteria: Confidence score produced within 10s for submitted questionnaire and evidence set
Portal shows tiered next-steps and contract options for vendors based on score
Automated verification flags for missing SOC2 artifacts and expired insurance
Contract templates populate customer/vendor fields and generate a PDF via existing contract service
Metrics dashboard surfaces median time-to-complete and percent auto-approved (target >=40% improvement)

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Over-reliance on automated scoring may miss contextual vendor exceptions. Mitigation: provide manual override and audit trail tied to reviewer identity.
Risk: Insurance PDFs are forged or stale. Mitigation: integrate checksum validation and automated expiration checks; require issuer information and spot verification for high-value vendors.
Risk: Legal/regulatory differences across regions. Mitigation: tier mapping includes region-specific thresholds and option to route to regional legal review.
